title: Grateful Dead Live at Charlotte Coliseum on 1973-12-10
lineage: master soundboard cassette > reel > pcm > dat > cdr

ai_review.summary: Soundboard partial from Dec 10 1973 delivers a solid performance with a smoking Casey Jones‑Jam‑One More Saturday Night suite and an outstanding China>Rider, but the incomplete set limits its overall appeal.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard source that captures a competent late‑'73 show. Highlights include a 45‑minute Casey Jones > Jam > One More Saturday Night sequence and a superb China Cat Sunflower > The Rider transition, while the rest of the set provides solid first‑set material. Because only a few tracks are present and there is some confusion about the exact date, listeners may find it less satisfying than a full concert release.

ai_rating.rationale: Positive remarks focus on the long jam and China>Rider, but many reviewers are disappointed by the partial nature and date confusion; recording quality is generally good, leading to a mixed‑positive overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audio is clear and well‑balanced typical of an SBD release; primary issues are the partial track list and occasional mislabeling of date/speed rather than sound problems.

standout_songs: Casey Jones > Jam > One More Saturday Night
show_quality.setlist_flow: Late‑1973 first‑set material flows well into a massive jam that transitions into the high‑energy encore, though only a fragment of the full concert is present.
